summary: Frontend-only fast follow-up to iteration_10. Verified the 2 fixes: (FIX 1) Batch Results mortality no longer shows placed-minus-caught/100% — on farm 'default' every shed row and the whole-farm KPI now show '—' for MORTALITY/TOTAL MORTS and there is no 100.00% anywhere on the page; (FIX 2) a genuinely fresh anonymous QR guest (cookies + localStorage cleared) at /?farm=default&t=<token> is NOT shown the 'Welcome to Broiler Base Mate' 5-step wizard — the new GET /api/farm-config check fires and sets feedmate-wizard-done=1; only the non-blocking 'FIRST 3 THINGS' nudge appears (allowed). Regression smoke all green: Archive tab lists the Double B locked batch, View Report visible, Resend Email returned '✓ Sent to appcovi2026@gmail.com'; anonymous /reader?farm=default&t=<token> loads the reader (no wizard); owner magic link lands on /ops-dashboard with 4 farms and the logout badge, and owner /?farm=default and /reader?farm=default both load fine. One NEW real defect found while checking the requested under-report regression: mortality logged through the Morts tab does NOT reach Batch Results (or Flock Forecast live birds) at all.

ui_bugs.issue: TOTAL MORTS renders '—' while MORTALITY % right next to it renders '0.00%'. Inconsistent placeholder for the same zero state (overallMortPct only guards on totalPlaced>0, not on totalMorts>0). Cosmetic but reads oddly next to the '—' cells.

integration_issues.flow: Morts tab -> Batch Results / Flock Forecast (requested under-report regression)
integration_issues.issue: Logged 50 morts for Shed 1 on Thu 3 Sept in the Morts tab (persisted as silo-morts-log={"2026-09-03":{"1":50}}, cell shows 50). Batch Results still shows Shed 1 MORTALITY '—', TOTAL MORTS '—', MORTALITY % 0.00%; Flock Forecast BIRDS LIVE stayed 527,309 (not 527,259). Root cause: BatchResultsView.shedStats only reads xlShed.morts (uploaded weigh-sheet xlsx) and EOB implied morts — mortsLog/cullsLog are never passed into BatchResultsView (see App.tsx ~11563 props list). So real daily-recorded mortality is invisible in Batch Results. The 100%-mortality bug is gone, but the metric now under-reports genuine morts.

action_items: MEDIUM: feed mortsLog + cullsLog (and shed-sheet COL_CATCH morts) into BatchResultsView.shedStats so mortality logged via the Morts tab appears in the ALL SHEDS RESULTS SUMMARY / per-shed cards and whole-farm TOTAL MORTS. Reuse the same MAX(eobMorts, dailyMorts) logic already used at App.tsx ~9720. Also check Flock Forecast BIRDS LIVE — it did not deduct the 50 logged morts either.
LOW: make TOTAL MORTS and MORTALITY % use the same zero placeholder (both '—' or both 0).
critical_code_review_comments: The wizard-suppression useEffect writes feedmate-wizard-done='1' permanently on any configured farm — correct for QR guests, but it also means a user who later starts a brand-new farm in the same browser will never see the wizard again. Consider gating on farm slug rather than a global flag.

The new check uses a relative fetch('/api/farm-config') instead of the REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL/env base. It works here (same-origin + fetch interceptor injects farm/token), but it is inconsistent with the rest of the codebase.

Mortality is now derived from three disconnected sources (xlsx weigh sheet, EOB sheet cols 22-24, mortsLog/cullsLog localStorage). This split is why the KPI first over-reported and now under-reports — worth consolidating into one selector/helper.

context_for_next_testing_agent: VERIFIED THIS ITERATION (do not retest): (1) Batch Results mortality shows '—' for all 12 sheds and whole-farm on 'default'; no 100%/100.0% string anywhere on the page (only percentage rendered is 0.00%). (2) Fresh anonymous QR guest sees NO wizard modal; feedmate-wizard-done=1 is set by the /api/farm-config effect; FIRST 3 THINGS nudge still shows and 'Skip tour' dismisses it. (3) Archive card + View Report + Resend Email ('✓ Sent to appcovi2026@gmail.com'). (4) anonymous /reader?farm=default&t=<token> loads. (5) owner magic link -> /ops-dashboard, then /?farm=default and /reader?farm=default load fine. NOT VERIFIED: whether the wizard still DOES appear for a genuinely unconfigured/new farm (no such farm exists in the preview DB) — worth a check after the wizard change. Selector notes: tab buttons carry emoji prefixes, so use page.get_by_role('button', name='Morts'/'Batch Results'/'Flock Forecast') non-exact; Archive has data-testid='tab-locked-batches-archive'; Morts grid cells are plain <td> with 'M'/'C' labels and the edit control is a visible number input (use input:visible last). Avoid wait_until='networkidle' on this app — it never settles (long-poll/sync) and times out.
rca_of_the_issue: FIX 1: shedStats now uses Math.max(xlShed.morts, impliedMorts-only-when-hasFinalCatch) so an in-progress batch with no catch rows reports 0 morts -> rendered as '—' (mortPct>0 guard at App.tsx 4091/4486). Confirmed live in the served dist bundle. FIX 2: showWizard's localStorage-only initialiser is now corrected by a mount-time GET /api/farm-config that dismisses and persists the done-flag when farmName/totalSheds/enabledGroupIds exist — confirmed on a cleared browser profile. Residual gap: the mortality fix only removed the false-positive source; it did not connect the true mortality source (mortsLog), so Batch Results now shows 0/'—' even when the grower has logged real daily morts.
